requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
requirement.note: Also matches §98.1103(b), the definition of algorithmic device (nonpublic data of two or more landlords), and §98.1104(a) remedies including fees to a prevailing tenant. The card omits the prevailing-landlord fee rule and the exclusions, which is acceptable in a summary.

key_value.evidence: For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
key_value.note: The $1,000 per violation cap is in §98.1104(a): "civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation". The separate-violation rule applies to 98.1103(b) use violations, not to sales.

effective_date.evidence: (“Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)

status.evidence: (“Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)
status.note: The document presents the division as current adopted code text with no repeal or sunset, so in_force as of 2026-10-01 is reasonable.

coverage.note: Coverage is null on the card.

citation.note: The cited sections 98.1102, 98.1103, 98.1104 and ordinance O-21955 N.S. all appear in the document.
